email.subject: Two things costing Polar Pros calls
email.body:
Hi Nora,

I looked at Polar Pros' site while researching Harbor Falls HVAC companies. Two issues likely cost you customers: there are no reviews shown anywhere, so homeowners comparing furnace or AC repair options have nothing to confirm you're trustworthy before they call a competitor instead. Also, the footer still shows an old copyright year, which makes the site look abandoned to anyone checking if you're still active.

I fix things like this for a flat fee, no retainer. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what I'd change and why?

Alex
Northlight Web
